name: Power from Pain
text: Your army keeps a pool of Pain tokens: one when the battle begins, one per enemy unit destroyed, one per enemy unit that fails a Battle-shock test. At the start of any phase, spend tokens to Empower units with this ability until phase end. Movement or Charge: re-roll Advance and Charge rolls. Shooting or Fight: re-roll Hit rolls.

name: Shadowfield
text: This model has a 2+ invulnerable save that can never be re-rolled. The first time a save made with it fails, the field collapses and the model has no invulnerable save for the rest of the battle.

name: Tormentors
text: When the Fight phase begins, every enemy unit within Engagement Range of a unit with this ability must take a Battle-shock test.
